# Customs

> Both sides of the agentic counter: the storefront AI buyers transact on, and the
> merchant desk that lets a payments company trust them — bounded, metered, replayable.

Built for the Razorpay AI Buildathon 2026, Track 1 (AI Growth & Agentic Commerce).
TypeScript monorepo.

## What is where

- `apps/storefront/` — buyer screen: chat intent → cart → bounded mandate → agent pays (Razorpay test-mode). Also the API surface external agents (HTTP / MCP / ACP-style) transact with.
- `apps/merchant/` — the Customs desk: traffic by protocol & trust tier, live channel P&L meter (agent GMV vs AI serving cost), blocks, span-by-span replay.
- `server/` — the gate: Ed25519-signed bounded mandates, trust-tier policy, hash-chained audit, protocol adapters, OTel instrumentation.

## Evidence index

- `JUDGE.md` — claims mapped to files and regenerate commands (the 60-second entry point)
- `ARCHITECTURE.md` — one diagram + decisions table
- `ENGINEERING_LOG.md` — dated incidents; every incident becomes a test
- `results/` — every measured number, JSON only, regeneration-only

## Verify

- `make verify` — the evidence checks CI runs on every push
- `make triage` — self-guided judge tour (prints claims, runs checks, exits 0)

Numbers are never hand-written; see `AGENTS.md` for the invariants that enforce it.
